name: Cluster Bomb
body:
School transmutation; Level machinesmith 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (alchemist’s fire worth 20 gp)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 10 ft. radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Reflex half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

The caster hurls a charged alchemist’s fire, which explodes into a shower of smaller bombs on impact, each dealing 3d6 points of fire damage plus an additional point of damge per caster level (maximum +15) to every creature in the area. While the first bomb is targeted to a specific square, the spell creates two additional bombs, which bounce as if a miss according to the standard splash weapon rules. The saving throw is made separately for each bomb.
